title: ChickenGuard Door Event Weekly Close Time Trend
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`), trail cams (`trailcam:detection`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chickenguard:door close_time=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(close_time) as avg_duration, max(close_time) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst close time for ChickenGuard door event events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture close_time on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average close time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It helps you whether ChickenGuard door event tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
